pairs.locus: Johannes de Alta Silva, De thesauro et fure astuto (father's speech)
pairs.question: Quid ergo tibi magis faciam?
pairs.answer: Hoc tantum unum superest consilii, sed periculosum, ut si ea largitate qua prius vivere vis, turrim in qua regis positi sunt thesauri sub obscurae noctis silentio adeamus.
pairs.derivation: The father poses the interrogative 'Quid ergo tibi magis faciam?' within his own speech and answers it himself. I cut the preamble 'Doleo quidem quod fama nomenque tuum in flore iuventutis deperit, sed unde te sustentem non habeo.' which laments but does not answer (per skip-non-answering-preamble), and start the answer at the operative sentence 'Hoc tantum unum superest consilii...'. The answer ends at its first full stop (before 'Audito hoc filius: ...'). Speech tag 'inquit' and the surrounding narration are dropped as framing.
